What is #BOPA?
BOPA - Buy Online Pickup Anywhere is a network of 36K+ pickup locations that online retailers and D2C brands can utilize as an alternative delivery offering to their customers in web check out.
These locations are made up of convenient retail locations that many customers visit routinely

How does BOPA and Pickup locations benefit your customers?
01
Low price of delivery:
Commercial deliveries are, in most cases, cheaper than residential deliveries since surcharges and assessorials are eliminated. These lower delivery rates should help your brand increase conversion when freight rates are published on your checkout
04
Enhanced Customer Experience:
Customers receive communication from Via.Delivery at every stage of the order delivery process, so they always know the status of their orders
03
Privacy:
Customers can be rest assured that gifts and other sensitive deliveries will be kept private and not intercepted by someone else.
02
Convenience:
Customers who want to ensure the security of their package from porch piracy, including urban areas where packages are left in mailrooms and front doors of apartment complexes can benefit from our BOPA solution and Pickup locations

Press About Via.Delivery and Pickup Locations

Startups offering everything from software platforms to personal care products are finding plenty of opportunity helping other companies deliver enhanced customer experiences, resulting in notable growth via business-to-business (B2B) transactions, a trio of startup executives told CO—.
Amazon revolutionized the online shopping experience with vast production selection, low costs, and fast shipping. Many of us are spoiled by the two-day shipping promised by Amazon Prime and the like.
Perry Ellis International customers can now pick up online orders from a wide range of brick-and-mortar sites. The specialty apparel retailer is leveraging the buy-online-pickup-anywhere (BOPA) solution from ViaDelivery.
Popular clothing, golf items can now be ordered online and picked up at one of more than 21,000 locations. Golf fans looking for a new outfit to pair with their golf game for next spring can now take advantage of convenient pickup options being offered through Via.Delivery.
